battlefield.note: The Atlantic west of Cape Trafalgar, with Cádiz to the north-east and Gibraltar, drawn much closer than it is, in the south-east.

popup.title: Trafalgar: Break the Line
popup.body:
You command the British fleet in two columns west of Cape Trafalgar. The French and Spanish ships outnumber yours, but they are strung out in a long line. Drive both columns through it, break it into pieces and fight each piece ship against ship before the far end can turn back to help. Your crews are veterans; keep your ships together and let the broadsides do the work. Ship counters stand for ships of the line and their consorts.

Objective: Sink the Combined Fleet.

On 21 October 1805 Nelson's fleet attacked the Franco-Spanish Combined Fleet off Cape Trafalgar in two columns, broke its line and captured or destroyed eighteen ships without losing one. Nelson was killed in the battle.

popup.title: England expects
popup.body: Signal from the flagship: England expects that every man will do his duty. The Combined Fleet is turning to meet you. Break its line in two places and fight it ship against ship.

popup.title: Collingwood's rear
popup.body: The last ships of the lee column are coming up from the south-west.

popup.title: Dumanoir's van turns back
popup.body: Admiral Dumanoir has brought the van round at last and is coming back down the line to rescue the flagship.

popup.title: Gravina's squadron
popup.body: Admiral Gravina's squadron of observation turns into the fight from the south.

popup.title: A storm is coming
popup.body: The swell is rising from the west and a storm is on its way. Finish the Combined Fleet before it breaks.
